title: Inflammatory Markers with Missing Printed Ranges
description: Tests where one biomarker has a printed reference range while others lack a printed range, requiring the system to return no_range_on_report without guessing.
raw_text:
DIAGNOSTIC PATHOLOGY CENTRE
Patient ID: PT-004
Date: 2026-11-10
--------------------------------------------------
Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR): 28 mm/hr (Ref Range: 0 - 15)
C-Reactive Protein (CRP): 7.4 mg/L
Blood Group & Rh Type: O Positive
Rheumatoid Factor (RA Factor): 18.0 IU/mL
--------------------------------------------------
Note: CRP and Blood Group do not have an automated interval printed on this slip.

values.explanation: Higher than the reference range printed on your report. ESR is a general marker related to inflammation.
Your report does not list a reference range for this test. Reference ranges vary across labs; please confirm this value with your doctor.
Blood grouping is a qualitative result identifying your blood type and Rh factor. It does not have a numerical reference range.
No reference range is printed for this test on your report. Discuss with your physician for clinical interpretation.

extracted_data.disclaimer: This explains your report. It does not replace your doctor.
